text: Which AI automation consultants in Brisbane specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

result.keyword: Which AI automation consultants in Brisbane specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

items.markdown:
In the Brisbane market, `several specialised technology consultancies` focus on the Microsoft AI and Power Platform stack (including Microsoft Copilot Studio, custom AI agents, and Power Automate workflow integration) tailored for mid-market organisations.

Prominent local specialists include:

- **Frontrow Technology** — Operating from Queen Street in the Brisbane CBD, this consultancy is led by a Microsoft MVP and focuses heavily on mid-market AI strategy, custom Copilot Studio agents, Azure AI Foundry workloads, and the underlying data governance scaffolding. While centered on the Microsoft ecosystem, they also adopt a multi-model approach where alternative tools (like Claude) fit specific workflows. You can evaluate their advisory services via the [Frontrow AI Consultant Brisbane](https://frontrowtech.com.au/ai-consultant-brisbane) page.[[1]](https://frontrowtech.com.au/ai-consultant-brisbane)
- **Itopia** — A Brisbane-based managed service and secure automation provider that explicitly focuses on practical AI rollouts using Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and Power Automate. Their mid-market approach prioritises data security foundations—such as cleaning up Microsoft 365 file permissions, establishing sensitivity labels, and setting up Data Loss Prevention (DLP) guardrails—before deploying custom AI workflow automation. More details can be found on the [Itopia Secure AI & Automation](https://itopia.com.au/what-we-do/ai-automation/) portal.[[1]](https://itopia.com.au/what-we-do/ai-automation/)

If you'd like to narrow this down, please let me know:

- What is your **current Microsoft licensing tier** (e.g., M365 Business Premium, E3, or E5)?
- Are you looking for **readiness and security governance** , or ready-to-build **custom customer/internal agents** right away?

I can help outline a **targeted scoping checklist** for your next steps.
